reviews.text: Highly recommended veterinary clinic. Professional, friendly, and completely trustworthy. You can feel the care and dedication of the entire team.
A very good experience. Friendly, professional service with a lot of love for the animals. I take my three poodles there and I'm delighted. Highly recommended!

I adopted a kitten (Chuty) and took him in for a walk-in checkup, and they still made the effort to see him. They were very caring and professional, and explained everything in great detail. One of the best vets I've ever been to; I highly recommend them!

I have two senior Bichons, Pluto and Rocky. Whenever we've needed them cared for, sometimes urgently, they've always found time. Excellent treatment, genuine affection, and constant monitoring of their progress. Thank you to Yolanda and the entire team.
We appreciate you taking a moment to rate us so positively, thank you from the bottom of our hearts.
I've known Eva and Yolanda for over 20 years. They are truly magnificent veterinarians. They've been with my kittens for their entire lives, from beginning to end.

I took my dog here to get registered as I recently moved here to Tetuan. They took very good care of my dog and were informative of her vaccinations; they also assisted us in registering her here in Madrid. The staff are all friendly and accommodating even if my Spanish is not yet that good. If you’re an expat looking for an english speaking vet, look for Dr. Carla—but I’m sure all the veterinarians here will take much care of you! We will be back. Thank you 😊
